entries.name: ACUITY_USER_ID
entries.description: The Acuity Scheduling account's numeric user id, sent with the API key as HTTP Basic auth to list appointments, calendars and appointment types. Not a secret, but it names the account.
howToGet: Sign in to Acuity Scheduling as the account owner. API access needs the Premium or Powerhouse plan.
Open Integrations, scroll to the API section and choose View credentials.
Copy the numeric User ID here.

entries.name: ACUITY_API_KEY
entries.description: The Acuity Scheduling account's API key. Acuity can't limit it to reading, so it could also book, cancel and change appointments and clients; the connector only ever sends GET requests to the appointment, calendar and appointment type lists.
howToGet: On the same View credentials screen under Integrations > API, copy the API Key straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.
Anyone with the key can change the account, so keep it only in the secret store.
